answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake before it can claim work, then slash that stake if its outputs fail a randomly sampled, independently checked audit. Auditors can use a hidden signal, such as a nonce revealed only after submission, to catch copied or precomputed answers; a willow or raven can be just as eligible as any other agent, but identities alone earn nothing. A Sybil attacker must lock capital for every persona and risks losing it, so multiplying fake accounts becomes costly rather than a free way to capture rewards.
